tasks.instruction: Pytania wlasne do mapy mysli OJAJ 2026/27 o Wielkiej Brytanii (nie z arkusza olimpiady). Z podanych odpowiedzi wybierz poprawna. Tylko jedna jest prawidlowa.

items.stem: Which king put his seal on the Magna Carta in 1215?
Where was the Magna Carta sealed?
options: A) at Runnymede, beside the River Thames
B) in the Tower of London

items.stem: Which king was made head of the Church of England by the Act of Supremacy in 1534?
Why did the king break with the Pope in Rome before the Act of Supremacy?
options: A) The Pope refused to crown him king.
B) The Pope would not annul his marriage to Catherine of Aragon.
C) The Pope had supported Spain in a war against England.
D) The Pope demanded that England pay higher taxes to Rome.

items.stem: Where did the Great Fire of London of 1666 start?
options: A) in the Tower of London
B) in a bakery in Pudding Lane

items.stem: Which famous building was destroyed in the Great Fire and rebuilt by Sir Christopher Wren?
What started the Suez Crisis in 1956?
options: A) Egypt's President Nasser took control of the Suez Canal.
B) Britain tried to build a second canal next to Suez.
C) The Suez Canal was closed by a storm for a year.
D) Israel bought the Suez Canal from France.

items.stem: How did the Suez Crisis end for Britain?
options: A) Britain won control of the canal for another fifty years.
B) Britain shared the canal with Egypt until 2000.
C) Britain and France had to withdraw, mainly under pressure from the USA.
D) Britain bought the canal back from Egypt.

Who was the British Prime Minister during the Falklands War?
